acts: FDA prescribing information published on DailyMed

en.title: idarubicin: 2.2 and 5.4 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 2.2 reads “If patients develop severe myelosuppression, reduce the dose of IDAMYCIN PFS by 25%”. 5.4 reads “Discontinue IDAMYCIN PFS in patients who develop severe myelosuppression”. Example: After severe myelosuppression in cycle 1, 2.2 directs the next cycle at a reduced dose and 5.4 directs discontinuation. The text is in this label.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
